name: IBY_FORMAT_TYPES_B
description: Stores all format types in Oracle Payments

columns.name: FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Format type code

columns.name: MESSAGE_DIRECTION
columns.description:
Whether the format type is for
                                               inbound or outbound. Inbound
                                               means the format is used to parse
                                               a file send from a trading
                                               partner to be consumed by the
                                               system; outbound means the system
                                               will generate an output file with
                                               the format.

columns.name: XML_SCHEMA_CODE
columns.description: XML schema code

columns.name: XML_SCHEMA_XDB_URL
columns.description: XML schema XDB URL

columns.name: LOADER_SERVICE_INTERFACE_CLASS
columns.description:
Full class name of the Loader SDO
                                               web service java client proxy
                                               interface. Product teams must
                                               provide a composite SDO which
                                               will be used by the framework to
                                               shred the interface XML to
                                               persistent storage (staging
                                               tables). Further they must
                                               provide a java client proxy for
                                               the SDO. The system will rely on
                                               the proxy to interact with the
                                               SDO.

columns.name: LOADER_SDO
columns.description: Top level SDO name.

columns.name: LOADER_SDO_MERGE_METHOD
columns.description:
The merge method of the SDO.
                                               Since the top level object which
                                               is the inbound file already
                                               exists in the database, this
                                               method will create the composite
                                               children only. The method should
                                               take only one parameter which is
                                               the SDO. It may return any java
                                               object as the result which is
                                               simply discarded. It should throw
                                               a java Exception in case of error
                                               such as insufficient table space.

columns.name: IMPORTER_SRVC_INTERFACE_CLASS
columns.description:
Full class name of the Importer
                                               web service java client proxy
                                               interface. Product teams must
                                               provide a web service as the
                                               importer code entry point.
                                               Further they must provide a java
                                               client proxy for the web service.
                                               The system will rely on the proxy
                                               to interact with the web service.

columns.name: IMPORT_METHOD
columns.description:
The import method. The method
                                               should take only one parameter
                                               which is the inbound file ID.
                                               Nothing should be returned i.e.,
                                               return is void in java. It should
                                               throw a java Exception in case of
                                               error such as insufficient table
                                               space.

columns.name: LOAD_PROGRAM_TYPE
columns.description: Program type for the inbound loader. Supported values are EJB_RMI and ADFBC

columns.name: EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Extract for format.

columns.name: BIP_CATALOG_REPORT_ABS_PATH
columns.description:
Stores the absolute path from the root to the xdo file for a report. E.g., /Payment Settlement/Disbursements/Outbound Payment Files/Printed Formats/Printed Formats.xdo.
Payments seed one BIP report per format type. The different formats for a format type will be stored as templates under the BIP report.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
